meta.titleBasketballGame: Basketball game — shoot hoops online in 3D for free — cv.cm
meta.descBasketballGame: Play a free 3D basketball shooting game in your browser: swipe or drag to shoot, score as many baskets as you can in 60 seconds or practise from five spots. Works on phones.

basketball-game.name: Basketball game
basketball-game.blurb: Shoot hoops for 60 seconds or practise.

basketball-game.a1: Drag or swipe up on the court: the direction of the swipe aims the shot and its length sets the strength. On a keyboard, aim with the left and right arrows, hold Space to fill the power meter and let go to shoot.
basketball-game.a2: A basket is worth 2 points, or 3 from the spot beyond the three-point line. From the third basket in a row, every basket earns 1 bonus point until you miss.
basketball-game.q3: What is the difference between the two modes?
basketball-game.a3: Timed mode gives you 60 seconds and moves you to a new spot after every three baskets. Practice has no clock: pick one of five spots and shoot as long as you like.
basketball-game.q4: What are a swish and a bank shot?
basketball-game.a4: A swish drops through without touching the rim or the board. A bank shot bounces off the backboard and in. Both count the same; the game tells you which one you made.
basketball-game.q5: Does it work on a phone?
basketball-game.a5: Yes. Swipe up on the court to shoot. Full screen gives you the most room. Your best timed score is kept in this browser.

basketball-game.lead: Play the basketball game in three steps.
basketball-game.s1b: Choose the 60-second timed round or practice from one of five spots, then press Play.
basketball-game.s2b: Drag or swipe up on the court. Aim with the direction and set the strength with the length, or use the arrow keys and Space.
basketball-game.s3b: Three baskets in a row and every basket earns a bonus point. Beat your best score before the clock runs out.
